basic_details.job_title: CURAJ Junior Research Fellow (Electronics and Communication Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering of the Central University of Rajasthan has invited applications for one temporary Junior Research Fellow post in the ISRO-sponsored project RES-SAC-2024-029, at Rs. 37000 + HRA (as per rules), initially for one year. Applicants must have a valid NET-JRF/GATE/NET/Others and must satisfy one of the listed degree criteria. Bio-data and documents go as a single PDF by email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Kapil Saraswat ([email protected]), on or before 8 December 2026.

qualification.details: Strong academic background in electromagnetics and RF and microwave engineering. Knowledge of electromagnetic simulation software, such as CST Studio Suite, Ansys Electronics Desktop, or MATLAB Antenna Toolbox. Familiarity with antenna measurement techniques and equipment, including anechoic chambers and vector network analysers (VNAs). Programming skills in Fortran, C/C++, Python, or MATLAB. | Discipline-specific eligibility is as printed in the official notification.

how_to_apply: Prepare the complete bio-data and copies of the certificates/documents as one single PDF file.
Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator of the project, Dr. Kapil Saraswat, at [email protected], on or before 8 December 2026.
Write the email subject exactly as: "Application for the position of JRF under ISRO-RESPOND Project".
Original certificates and documents, to be brought to the interview

For technical information on the project, candidates may contact the Principal Investigator at the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Central University of Rajasthan, 305817, Ajmer, Rajasthan, INDIA.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Calling for interview is not a guarantee for selection. The committee reserves the right not to select any candidate or to offer a lower post if candidates are not found suitable for the applied post. Candidates should appear for the interview along with their original certificates and documents. No communications will be entertained for being called/not called and/or selected/not selected for the advertised position.

content_sections.heading: CURAJ Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: "RES-SAC-2024-029: Development of a MATLAB tool for antenna diagnostics using amplitude only field measurement and source reconstruction method"
Initially one year, extendable by a further year subject to satisfactory performance, up to a maximum of two years

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy one of the following criteria and must have a valid NET-JRF/GATE/NET/Others: M.Tech./M.E. or an equivalent degree in RF and Microwave Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field. A four-year bachelor's degree or a five-year integrated degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field. PG Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: (a) scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE; (b) the selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER etc. Priority will be given to a candidate eligible for JRF. The notice does not state an age limit. Strong academic background in electromagnetics and RF and microwave engineering. Knowledge of electromagnetic simulation software, such as CST Studio Suite, Ansys Electronics Desktop, or MATLAB Antenna Toolbox. Familiarity with antenna measurement techniques and equipment, including anechoic chambers and vector network analysers (VNAs). Programming skills in Fortran, C/C++, Python, or MATLAB. Discipline-specific eligibility is as printed in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly compensation / fellowship for the Junior Research Fellow is Rs. 37000 + HRA (as per rules). The tenure is initially one year. It is extendable by a further year subject to satisfactory performance, up to a maximum of two years. Accommodation in the University hostel may be provided subject to availability.

content_sections.heading: CURAJ Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Implementation of algorithms for amplitude-only field measurement and source reconstruction using MATLAB, Python, C, or C++.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CURAJ Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare the complete bio-data and copies of the certificates/documents as one single PDF file. Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator of the project, Dr. Kapil Saraswat, at [email protected] , on or before 8 December 2026. Write the email subject exactly as: "Application for the position of JRF under ISRO-RESPOND Project". Complete bio-data 10th marksheet 12th marksheet UG marksheet PG marksheet (if available) GATE/NET score card (if available) Original certificates and documents, to be brought to the interview For technical information on the project, candidates may contact the Principal Investigator at the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Central University of Rajasthan, 305817, Ajmer, Rajasthan, INDIA.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for the interview based on merit. The scrutiny committee has the right to put any screening criteria in case large numbers of applications are received. Selected candidates will be called for an interview at the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Central University of Rajasthan. It can be in Offline/Online mode, and the date will be informed to the selected candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be informed only by e-mail/Mobile, and no separate letter will be issued for the interview.

content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Calling for interview is not a guarantee for selection. Candidates should appear for the interview along with their original certificates and documents. No communications will be entertained for being called/not called and/or selected/not selected for the advertised position.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts are there in the CURAJ ISRO-RESPOND project?
faq.answer: There is 1 Junior Research Fellow post, a temporary post in the project RES-SAC-2024-029 in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CURAJ JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 8 December 2026 (08-12-2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the CURAJ JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must satisfy one of the listed criteria, such as M.Tech./M.E. or a four-year bachelor's or five-year integrated degree in the specified fields, and must have a valid NET-JRF/GATE/NET/Others.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the CURAJ Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly compensation / fellowship is Rs. 37000 + HRA (as per rules).

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37000 for the CURAJ JRF?
faq.answer: The notice states the pay as Rs. 37000 + HRA (as per rules), so HRA is mentioned in addition to the Rs. 37000, subject to the rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CURAJ JRF post?
faq.answer: Send the complete bio-data and certificate copies as a single PDF by email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Kapil Saraswat ([email protected]), with the subject "Application for the position of JRF under ISRO-RESPOND Project".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for the CURAJ JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted for the interview based on merit, and the interview can be in Offline/Online mode. The date will be informed to the shortlisted candidates by e-mail/Mobile.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the CURAJ JRF tenure?
faq.answer: The tenure is initially one year, extendable by a further year subject to satisfactory performance, up to a maximum of two years.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the CURAJ interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is accommodation available for the CURAJ JRF?
faq.answer: Accommodation in the University hostel may be provided subject to availability.
